adaptations.withheld: sacred or restricted dance: no teaching adaptations

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Right hand palm faces upward, left hand palm faces downward; arms move subtly to express spiritual symbolism.
movement_profile.difficulty: Beginner to intermediate; emphasis on spiritual focus rather than technical complexity.
movement_profile.footwork: Circular stepping around a central point, alternating slow and fast steps; rotation on own axis synchronized with group movement.
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Dancers form a circle or pairs facing each other, moving around a central point in coordinated rotations.
movement_profile.hips_and_torso: Rotate smoothly with the body’s turning motion, maintaining balance and fluidity.
movement_profile.levels_and_jumps: No jumps; movement is low-impact and focused on rotation and stepping.
movement_profile.partnering: Often danced in pairs or small groups facing each other, no physical contact required.
movement_profile.posture: Upright with gentle rotation on the vertical axis, hands held with right palm up and left palm down.

signature_moves.description: Imitation of the crane’s flight with graceful arm and body movements in circular rotation.
signature_moves.name: Turnalar semahı

signature_moves.description: Dance symbolizing the forty saints, performed in a circular formation with synchronized rotations.
signature_moves.name: Kırklar semahı

movement_profile.tempo_feel: Alternates between slow, meditative pace and faster rhythmic steps matching the aksak meter.
movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Avoid ostentatious or profane movements; maintain solemnity and control; do not perform outside sacred contexts.

music_profile.musical_form: Structured to support meditative, trance-like states with alternating tempos
music_profile.rhythm_pattern: Alternating slow and fast beats characteristic of aksak
music_profile.sound_description: The music features the saz lute playing melodic lines over an aksak rhythmic base, accompanied by soft percussion and spiritual vocal chants, creating a contemplative and hypnotic atmosphere.
music_profile.vocal_style: Devotional singing of hymns (qawl and bayt), poetry praising Allah, Muhammad, Ali, and spiritual figures

basic_steps: Stand in a circle or paired formation facing each other.
Raise right hand palm upward, left hand palm downward.
Begin slow circular stepping around the center point.
Rotate the body gently on own axis while moving in circle.
Alternate between slow and faster steps following rhythm.
teaching.formation: Mixed-gender groups dancing side by side, often in pairs or small groups facing each other in a circle.
teaching.level_notes: Beginners start with basic circular stepping and hand positioning, progressing to synchronized rotations and animal-inspired gestures.
teaching.rhythm: Aksak meter, an uneven rhythmic pattern alternating slow and fast beats.
